notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
- Added a volume slider
- Adjusted the corresponding localization text 
- Adjusted the UI to look a little cleaner
- Reworked the Normalization logic

notes.title: Bug Patches
notes.notes:
Fixed: 
- Windows Volume Normalization (Volume no longer affects the amplitude of the pixels)
- Window launch bug (User no longer has to click out of and into the app to make it responsive)

notes.title: New Feature!
notes.notes:
Feature Added:
✅️Undockable floating control panel window

notes.title: Localization Support
notes.notes: Added language support for: English, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), French, German, Irish, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian & Spanish.

notes.title: New Features!
notes.notes:
New Features added:
✅️back button
✅️windowed mode
✅️reset buttons for default slider values
✅️background environment toggle
✅️hotkey for mouse visibility
✅️hotkey for menu visibility
✅️Expandable bar colour/transparency

notes.title: File Size Optimization
notes.notes: Overall optimization and deletion of unused files and plugins
